title.en: Text reveal by line, word and letter

summary.zh-TW: 同一個外掛的三種拆法：英文標題一行一行從遮罩升起、英文句子一個單字一個單字浮現、中文一個字一個字亮起來。
summary.en: Three ways to split with the same plugin: an English headline rising line by line from a mask, an English sentence appearing word by word, and letters lighting up one by one.

text.zh-TW: 依照「畫面上實際的換行」拆成一行一行。適合大標題；搭配 mask 就是常見的「從下方升起」效果。
text.en: Splits by the actual line breaks on screen. Great for headlines; add a mask and you get the classic rise-from-below effect.

text.zh-TW: 依照空格拆成單字。只適合英文：中文沒有空格，整句會被當成一個字。
text.en: Splits on spaces. English only — Chinese has no spaces, so a whole sentence counts as one word.

text.zh-TW: 拆成每一個字元。中文要逐字動畫就用這個。字元越多越耗效能，長段落建議改用 lines。
text.en: Splits into every character. Use it for per-character animation in Chinese. More characters cost more performance, so prefer lines for long paragraphs.

text.zh-TW: 在每一行外面包一層會裁切的遮罩，文字從遮罩下方升上來時不會露出來。首頁的 Motion Lab 也是用這招（mask: chars）。
text.en: Wraps each line in a clipping mask so text stays hidden while it rises from below. The home page Motion Lab title uses the same trick (mask: chars).

text.zh-TW: 字體載入或視窗變寬變窄時，換行位置會改變。autoSplit 會自動重新拆分，onSplit 回傳的動畫會自動接上，不會錯位。
text.en: Line breaks change when fonts load or the window resizes. autoSplit re-splits automatically and the animation returned from onSplit is reconnected, so nothing drifts.
